description: Rules for an AI coding agent to filter out generic AI-generated UI designs, text, and code.

latest_release.name: v3.2.30: Kilo Code joins the installer
latest_release.body:
**Kilo Code joins the installer, and two community fixes ride along.** Kilo reads the shared `.agents/skills` folder at both scopes, so it costs one row and no new path. A new `antislop-ui` pattern covers the navigation shell, and the installer's prompt library moves to its current release.

## One shared folder, no new path

Kilo Code documents `.kilo/skills/` for a project and `~/.kilo/skills/` at user level, but it also loads `.agents/skills/` by default at both scopes. That is the folder Antigravity, Copilot, Kimi Code, Amp, DeepSeek Harness, and Muse Code already share, so the installer writes one copy and Kilo joins without a new folder. The installer now covers fifteen agents over nine folders.

Kilo also reads `.claude/skills/`, but only when its Claude Code Compatibility setting is on, which is off by default. The installer does not count it as a second copy for that reason. If you already keep skills in `.kilo/skills/`, do not copy antislop there as well: Kilo does not document which copy wins.

For instructions, Kilo discovers `AGENTS.md` at the project root and in parent folders, so a project install writes the same pointer it writes for the other agents.

## Scaffold Sidebar

The new pattern in `antislop-ui` names a page that got a design pass while the navigation did not: one flat list of eight or more identical rows, an active state that is only a slightly darker tint, no hover or pressed state, a collapse that clips labels mid-word, and on a phone a rail that disappears with no trigger.

The shell is on every screen, so its defects are paid on every navigation. It is the most-seen part of the product and the one most often left at the starter default. The fix treats the shell as a component: grouped destinations, a current marker that survives icon-only and mobile, a real collapse button with `aria-expanded`, an accessible name for every icon-only destination, and a mobile sheet with a trigger, Escape to close, and focus returned to the trigger. The checklist gains the matching item.

From community PR #65.

## The prompt library refresh

The installer moves `@clack/prompts` from 1.7.0 to 1.9.0. The APIs the installer uses did not change, the lockfile was regenerated with the new resolution, and the smoke test passes on the new version. No prompt, question, or hint was rewritten for it.

From community PR #64.

## What is verified, and what is not

This repository passes its own check, fourteen checks in all, and the installer smoke test. The smoke test pins Kilo's project target, its global target, its pointer file, and the new counts: fifteen agents over nine folders.

Kilo Code is the one part read from the vendor's current documentation rather than from a live install. The documentation states the shared folder at both scopes and the `AGENTS.md` discovery, and the installer pins those paths, but no Kilo Code session on this machine has loaded the skills. That stays unclaimed rather than assumed.

Both community changes are in the tree those checks ran against.

## Updating

The installer route is unchanged:

```bash
npx antislop-ai --update
```

It replaces every antislop folder already on this machine at both scopes, keeps each folder's skill selection, and prints the release it replaced. A Kilo Code project that was installed before this release has no antislop folder yet, so run `npx antislop-ai` once and select Kilo Code. Skills load when a session starts, so start a new one afterwards.

The plugin doors are unaffected by this release. Each keeps its own copy and updates through its own manager.

detail.readme:
# Anti Slop: Rules for AI Coding Agents npx antislop-ai [Website](https://antislop.ai.id) · [Guide](GUIDE.md) · [Roadmap](ROADMAP.md) · [Install](#install) · [Skills](#skills) · [FAQ](#faq) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/antislop-ai?style=flat-square&color=cb3837&label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/antislop-ai) [![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-20.12%2B-339933?style=flat-square&logo=nodedotjs&logoColor=white)](cli/package.json) [![skills.sh](https://skills.sh/b/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop?style=flat-square)](https://skills.sh/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop) [![MIT license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-f4c430?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-join-5865F2?style=flat-square&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/VWKggJfHFR)
--- **antislop** is a rulebook an AI coding agent reads every session. It stops generic UI, text, and AI-shaped code, and it is a filter, not a style guide: no colors, fonts, or layouts prescribed, direction stays yours. Inside are 40 rules in three tiers, a Liveliness Toolkit, a mandatory PASS/FAIL report, and six skills that load only when a task needs them. It cannot invent direction, so DESIGN.md supplies that, and antislop never beautifies on its own. ## Before and after Each pair below is one brief, run twice, so the difference is visible side by side. ### UI With /antislop-ui. antislop alone is not the after. It removes the slop and stops there; direction comes from `DESIGN.md`. For UI work you intend to ship, that file is mandatory: without it the result is labelled a draft without direction. The pair below is the result. | **Before: without antislop** | **After: antislop + `DESIGN.md`** | |:--|:--| | | | | This is what most AI output looks like: slop everywhere once you take a closer look. | Much better. antislop kills the slop, and `DESIGN.md` gives it a real visual direction. | The two partial states are worth seeing, because each one shows why the other half matters: | **Partial: antislop alone** | **Partial: `DESIGN.md` alone** | |:--|:--| | | | | The slop is gone, but so is the direction. That is why antislop needs a `DESIGN.md`. | The direction is there, but honestly it is still far from good: the slop still shows. | ### Copywriting With /antislop-copywriting. One prompt, run twice. ### Accessibility With /antislop-human. One sign-in form, run twice. ### Mobile layout With /antislop-layoutmobile. One dashboard on a phone, run twice. ### Code With /antislop-code. One file, run twice. Every image here opens full size if you click it. ## Install antislop ships as standard agent skills: one folder per skill, holding a `SKILL.md`. Installation differs per agent, so pick the section for the one you use. Each route is walked through from zero, with update and removal, in [GUIDE.md](GUIDE.md#install-update-and-remove). ### The installer (recommended) One command, then answer the prompts. It asks which skills you want, where to install them (this project or everywhere), and which agents you use, then copies the folders and writes the pointer that reloads antislop every session. ```bash npx antislop-ai ``` ### The skills directory antislop is listed on [skills.sh](https://skills.sh/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop), the open directory for agent skills. This copies the same folders as the installer and nothing else, so antislop reloads by description alone. ```bash npx skills add miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop ``` ### Claude Code - Plugin ```text /plugin marketplace add https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop /plugin install antislop@anti-slop ``` ### Antigravity - Plugin ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop ``` ### Codex - Plugin ```bash codex plugin marketplace add miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop codex plugin add antislop@anti-slop ``` ### Cursor - Plugin ```bash agent plugin marketplace add https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop ``` Then open **Customize**, find **antislop**, and select **Install**. ### Kimi Code - Plugin ```text /plugins install https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop ``` ### DeepSeek Harness - Plugin Open **Plugins**, choose **Add plugin**, paste this package name, and select **Install**: ```text antislop-ai ``` That is the desktop route. From a terminal instead, name the profile you use: ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add antislop-ai ``` ### Cline - Plugin ```bash cline plugin install https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop.git ``` This door covers the Cline CLI. For the VS Code or JetBrains extension, use the installer. ### Muse Code - Plugin Muse Code keeps its plugin system behind an opt-in flag, so set it first. On macOS and Linux: ```bash export MUSE_EXPERIMENTAL_PLUGINS=1 muse plugins marketplace add anti-slop miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop muse plugins install antislop@anti-slop ``` On Windows, set `$env:MUSE_EXPERIMENTAL_PLUGINS = "1"` in PowerShell first, then run the two `muse` lines unchanged. Skills load without another step. Run `muse plugins approve antislop` to enable the contrast MCP server. ### Oh My Pi - Plugin ```bash omp plugin marketplace add miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop omp plugin install antislop@anti-slop ``` ### Pi - Package ```bash pi install git:github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop ``` ### The single file `antislop.md` on its own is a complete filter you can paste into any chat window, with no packaging and no folders. ```bash curl -o antislop.md https://raw.githubusercontent.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop/main/antislop.md ``` ## Skills | Skill | Covers | Pick it for | |-------|--------|-------------| | antislop | The core filter: rules, tiers, the Delivery Gate, liveliness | Everything. Always loaded | | antislop-ui | Layout, color, components, decoration, motion, structure, performance | UI and visual work | | antislop-copywriting | Headlines, CTAs, tone, fake stats, anti-AI writing, markdown hygiene | Copy and text | | antislop-human | Contrast, keyboard, focus, states, interaction affordances | Accessibility | | antislop-layoutmobile | Reflow across screen widths, breakpoints, grids, overflow, tap targets | Responsive work | | antislop-code | AI-slop comments: which to remove, which to keep | Comment cleanup | Install one, several, or the core alone. ## Usage modes antislop runs one of two ways, and by default the agent asks which at the start of every session. - **During** guides the work while it is built, and closes with the Delivery Gate report. - **After** audits work that already exists: a numbered findings list, you approve what to fix, then a follow-up report. To skip the question, save a preference once: ```bash npx antislop-ai --mode during ``` Use `after` for the other mode. Everything else, from `--mode ask` to where the setting lives, is in [GUIDE.md](GUIDE.md#usage-modes). ## Update antislop does not update itself. If you installed through the installer, one command replaces what is already there, in this project and under your home directory, and prints the release it replaced: ```bash npx antislop-ai --update ``` A plugin keeps its own copy under the agent that installed it, so it updates through its own command, and the Pi package updates through Pi. Every route is listed in [GUIDE.md](GUIDE.md#install-update-and-remove). Skills load when a session starts, so start a new one afterwards. ## FAQ **Is antislop a style guide?** No, a filter. It rejects technique without purpose and requires liveliness. Direction is yours. **Which agents does it work with?** Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, OpenCode, Cursor, Cline, Amp, Gemini CLI, Hermes, GitHub Copilot, Kimi Code, DeepSeek Harness, Muse Code, Kilo Code, Pi, and Oh My Pi. The installer covers fifteen of them and detects which ones you have, and the plugin doors install from this same repository. [GUIDE.md](GUIDE.md) lists the folder each agent reads. **What is a skill?** A folder that goes deeper into one concern, holding a `SKILL.md` with its rules. Skills reference the core rules by number and never duplicate them, so adding one does not change the core. ## Roadmap **v3.2.30** adds Kilo Code to the installer: - **Shared folder.** Kilo Code reads `.agents/skills` at both scopes, the folder Antigravity, Copilot, Kimi Code, Amp, DeepSeek Harness, and Muse Code already share. - **A folder of its own.** Kilo Code also documents `.kilo/skills/`, but the shared folder is loaded by default, so the installer writes one copy. Every earlier release, and what comes next, is in [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md). ## Star History [![Star History Chart](https://api.star-history.com/svg?repos=miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop&type=Date)](https://star-history.com/#miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop&Date) ## Contributors Thanks to everyone who helps make antislop better.

Found a new slop pattern, a rule that missed something, or a bug in the installer? Open an [issue](https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop/issues). What a pull request has to carry is in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), and behavior in issues and pull requests is covered by [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

“antislop is a filter, not magic.
It clears the slop from your UI, text, and code.
A beautiful UI is DESIGN.md's job, and yours.”

## Disclaimer Get antislop from [miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop](https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop), [antislop.ai.id](https://antislop.ai.id), or the [antislop-ai npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/antislop-ai). The npm name `antislop` belongs to a different package, so `npx antislop` does not install this project. There is no antislop coin, token, or fundraising. Any crypto coin, token, NFT, or fundraising that uses the antislop name was not created by this project and is a scam. antislop accepts donations only through the Sponsor button on this repository and [Saweria](https://saweria.co/antislop); anyone collecting money in its name anywhere else is not authorized. ## License MIT: [LICENSE](LICENSE)
